description: A compensation boundary event associated with another activity names that activity as the compensation handler.
bpmn:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:awa="https://awa.io/schema/interchange/1.1" id="Definitions_comp" targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn">
<bpmn:process id="P" name="Booking">
<bpmn:startEvent id="S"/>
<bpmn:serviceTask id="T_book" name="Book hotel"/>
<bpmn:serviceTask id="T_pay" name="Charge card"/>
<bpmn:serviceTask id="T_cancel" name="Cancel hotel" isForCompensation="true"/>
<bpmn:boundaryEvent id="B" attachedToRef="T_book"><bpmn:compensateEventDefinition id="CED"/></bpmn:boundaryEvent>
<bpmn:endEvent id="E"/>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="S" targetRef="T_book"/>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="T_book" targetRef="T_pay"/>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="T_pay" targetRef="E"/>
<bpmn:association id="A" sourceRef="B" targetRef="T_cancel" associationDirection="One"/>
</bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
